attributes.name: [Chargeback Serverless] Project daily spend threshold exceeded

esqlQuery.esql:
FROM serverless_billing_cost_lookup
| EVAL threshold_spend = 200.0, filter_project = "*", filter_driver = "*"
| INLINE STATS latest_day = MAX(@timestamp)
| WHERE @timestamp == latest_day
| EVAL ts = @timestamp
| WHERE ts IS NOT NULL
| RENAME project_id AS _b_pid, project_name AS _b_pname, project_type AS _b_ptype, has_native_billing AS _b_has_nat, conf_chargeable_unit_rate AS _b_rate, conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit AS _b_unit, conf_currency_symbol AS _b_sym
| LOOKUP JOIN serverless_project_status_lookup ON composite_key
| RENAME conf_chargeable_unit_rate AS _ps_rate, conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit AS _ps_unit, conf_currency_symbol AS _ps_sym
| EVAL @timestamp = ts
| EVAL project_id = COALESCE(_b_pid, project_id)
| EVAL project_name = CASE(_b_pname IS NOT NULL AND _b_pname != "" AND _b_pname != project_id, _b_pname, project_name IS NOT NULL AND project_name != "" AND project_name != project_id, project_name, _b_pname IS NOT NULL AND _b_pname != "", _b_pname, project_name IS NOT NULL AND project_name != "", project_name, project_id)
| EVAL project_type = CASE(_b_ptype IS NOT NULL AND _b_ptype != "" AND _b_ptype != "unknown", _b_ptype, project_type IS NOT NULL AND project_type != "", project_type, _b_ptype)
| EVAL _b_u_clean = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(_b_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(_b_unit)), null), _ps_u_clean = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(_ps_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(_ps_unit)), null), _b_s_clean = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(_b_sym)) > 0, TRIM(_b_sym), null), _ps_s_clean = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(_ps_sym)) > 0, TRIM(_ps_sym), null)
| EVAL _prefer_ps_cur = (NOT COALESCE(_b_has_nat, false) AND _ps_u_clean IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(_b_u_clean, "USD") == "USD" AND COALESCE(_b_rate, 1.0) == 1.0)
| EVAL _row_rate = CASE(_prefer_ps_cur, COALESCE(_ps_rate, _b_rate, 1.0), COALESCE(_b_rate, _ps_rate, 1.0)), _row_unit = CASE(_prefer_ps_cur, COALESCE(_ps_u_clean, _b_u_clean, "USD"), COALESCE(_b_u_clean, _ps_u_clean, "USD")), _row_sym = CASE(_prefer_ps_cur, COALESCE(_ps_s_clean, _b_s_clean, "$"), COALESCE(_b_s_clean, _ps_s_clean, "$"))
| EVAL _cfg_key = "chargeback_config"
| LOOKUP JOIN serverless_chargeback_conf_lookup ON _cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| RENAME conf_chargeable_unit_rate AS _cfg_rate, conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit AS _cfg_unit, conf_currency_symbol AS _cfg_sym
| DROP _cfg_key, config_join_key, conf_start_date, conf_end_date
| EVAL _cu = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(_cfg_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(_cfg_unit)), null), _cs = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(_cfg_sym)) > 0, TRIM(_cfg_sym), null)
| EVAL conf_chargeable_unit_rate = COALESCE(_cfg_rate, _row_rate, 1.0), unit = COALESCE(_cu, _row_unit, "USD"), currency_symbol = COALESCE(_cs, _row_sym, "$")
| EVAL _is_auth_cur = (_cu IS NOT NULL OR COALESCE(_b_has_nat, false) OR _ps_u_clean IS NOT NULL OR unit != "USD" OR conf_chargeable_unit_rate != 1.0)
| EVAL _au = CASE(_is_auth_cur, unit, null)
| INLINE STATS _auth_unit = MAX(_au), _any_unit = MAX(unit)
| EVAL rep_unit = COALESCE(_auth_unit, _any_unit, "USD")
| EVAL _ar = CASE(_is_auth_cur AND unit == rep_unit, conf_chargeable_unit_rate, null), _rr = CASE(unit == rep_unit, conf_chargeable_unit_rate, null), _as = CASE(_is_auth_cur AND unit == rep_unit, currency_symbol, null), _rs = CASE(unit == rep_unit, currency_symbol, null)
| INLINE STATS _auth_rate = MAX(_ar), _any_rate = MAX(_rr), _auth_sym = MAX(_as), _any_sym = MAX(_rs)
| EVAL rep_rate = COALESCE(_auth_rate, _any_rate, 1.0), rep_sym = COALESCE(_auth_sym, _any_sym, CASE(rep_unit == "EUR", "€", rep_unit == "GBP", "£", rep_unit == "ZAR", "R", "$"))
| EVAL eff_rate = CASE(unit == rep_unit, conf_chargeable_unit_rate, rep_rate), unit = rep_unit, currency_symbol = rep_sym
| DROP _b_has_nat, _b_u_clean, _ps_u_clean, _b_s_clean, _ps_s_clean, _prefer_ps_cur, _is_auth_cur, _au, _auth_unit, _any_unit, _ar, _rr, _as, _rs, _auth_rate, _any_rate, _auth_sym, _any_sym, rep_unit, rep_rate, rep_sym
| EVAL units = CASE(total_ecu IS NOT NULL, total_ecu, 0.0)
| EVAL cost = units * eff_rate
| DROP eff_rate
| EVAL project = CASE(project_name IS NOT NULL AND project_name != "", project_name, project_id IS NOT NULL AND project_id != "", project_id, "organization")
| EVAL project_type_label = CASE(project_type IS NOT NULL AND project_type != "", project_type, "organization")
| EVAL category_label = COALESCE(cost_category, "other")
| EVAL cost_type_label = COALESCE(cost_type, "other")
| EVAL workload_driver = CASE(
    cost_type_label IN ("ingest-vcu", "ingest") OR allocation_driver == "indexing", "indexing",
    cost_type_label IN ("search-vcu", "search") OR allocation_driver == "query", "search",
    cost_type_label == "retained" OR allocation_driver == "storage", "storage",
    allocation_driver == "ai" OR cost_type_label IN ("inference", "ml-vcu", "agent-builder"), "ai",
    allocation_driver == "synthetics" OR cost_type_label == "synthetics", "synthetics",
    "unallocatable"
  )
| EVAL project_type = project_type_label, day = LEFT(TO_STRING(@timestamp), 10)
| WHERE (filter_project == "*" OR project == filter_project OR project_id == filter_project)
    AND (filter_driver == "*" OR workload_driver == filter_driver)
| EVAL idx_c = CASE(workload_driver == "indexing", cost, 0.0),
       sch_c = CASE(workload_driver == "search", cost, 0.0),
       stg_c = CASE(workload_driver == "storage", cost, 0.0),
       ai_c  = CASE(workload_driver == "ai", cost, 0.0),
       syn_c = CASE(workload_driver == "synthetics", cost, 0.0)
| STATS
    spend = ROUND(SUM(cost), 2),
    ecu = ROUND(SUM(units), 2),
    indexing_spend = ROUND(SUM(idx_c), 2),
    search_spend = ROUND(SUM(sch_c), 2),
    storage_spend = ROUND(SUM(stg_c), 2),
    ai_spend = ROUND(SUM(ai_c), 2),
    synthetics_spend = ROUND(SUM(syn_c), 2),
    threshold = MAX(threshold_spend),
    sym = COALESCE(MAX(currency_symbol), "$"),
    unit = COALESCE(MAX(unit), "USD")
  BY day, project, project_id, project_type
| WHERE spend > threshold
| SORT spend DESC
| EVAL result = CONCAT("[", day, "] Project `", project, "` (", project_id, ", ", project_type, ") daily spend of ", sym, TO_STRING(spend), " ", unit, " (", TO_STRING(ecu), " ECU; indexing=", sym, TO_STRING(indexing_spend), ", search=", sym, TO_STRING(search_spend), ", storage=", sym, TO_STRING(storage_spend), ", ai=", sym, TO_STRING(ai_spend), ", synthetics=", sym, TO_STRING(synthetics_spend), ") exceeded threshold of ", sym, TO_STRING(threshold), " ", unit, ".")
| KEEP result, day, project, project_id, project_type, spend, ecu, indexing_spend, search_spend, storage_spend, ai_spend, synthetics_spend, threshold, unit
